How we choose

Our editorial standards

No pay-for-placement

Resorts and products don’t appear in our roundups because they paid to — they appear because they earned it on the merits described in the review.

We disclose affiliate links clearly

When a link is commercial, we say so, in plain language, on the same page — see our affiliate disclosure for the details.

We update, not just publish

Every guide shows a publish date and, where relevant, a last-updated date. Prices, opening hours, and policies change; we try to keep pace.

We show trade-offs, not just highlights

A useful review names what a resort or destination is bad at, not only what it’s good at. Pros-and-cons sections aren’t decorative.

Have a correction, or think we got something wrong? We'd genuinely like to know —get in touch.
